_comment: Sandbox-specific delta applied on top of the srt-policy-packs generic-agent pack. Entries here are UNIONED with the pack's (pack order first, overlay extras appended); the overlay never removes a pack entry, so an upstream deny always survives the merge. Regenerate srt-settings.json with tools/sync-srt-policy.sh after editing this file.
_settings_comment: Default srt policy for untrusted commands inside the sandbox. Deny-by-default egress: only the domains a personal-OSS workflow needs. enableWeakerNestedSandbox is required inside Docker (no privileged namespaces) and weakens isolation vs host srt — treat this as an egress allowlist plus a secrets fence, not a kernel boundary. Installed to ~/.srt-settings.json by the entrypoint when absent; edit the copy in your home volume to customize.
